name: Miyama Yukimi
source: Yukimi is [url=/c97358]Misaki's[/url] childhood friend. She supports Misaki no matter what happens, but for a good reason she has been called an "atrocious person" by her. She's also friends with [url=/c97357]Kouzuki Mio[/url]. Together they're helping Misaki find out what happened to [url=/c97354]Orihara Kouhei[/url].
